PURPOSE

Turn the shell's identity, accessibility, and interaction promises into executable product-level browser laws. These courts cover the interactive app and complement, but do not weaken, the separate no-JavaScript static-preview contract.

ACCEPTANCE

- Use the product-controlled or project Playwright browser and obey the repository browser-ownership audit before and after each run.
- Test keyboard-only focus and selection, visible focus, logical reading order, aria-pressed/state announcements, reduced motion, deterministic gesture hysteresis, and stale-result rejection.
- At 200 percent zoom and DPR 2, assert no clipped quantitative labels, mark/label collisions that alter meaning, hue-only distinctions, or invisible selected/off-projection states.
- Check computed contrast and structural non-colour encodings, not merely palette declarations.
- Prove Address-based semantic selection resolves through SceneNavigation/NavigationIndex while data-name remains MarkId/AnnotationId/FragmentId.
- Assert no external requests, no copied story text in the shell, printed horizon/checksums, and parity between DOM text, overlays, textual twins, and receipts.
- Add regression fixtures for the defects recorded in the rejected mockup review, including clipped scale maxima, incomplete diagnostics, rest-position drift, unreadable recall destinations, dead declared tabs, and missing synthetic banners.
- Keep DPR 2 capture as a review precondition; close all browser pages, contexts, processes, and temporary profiles owned by the session.

2026-09-22 WORKSPACE DESIGN CATALOG
Governing implementation design: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md; granular crosswalk is section 10.3. Live Mote owns status. Existing scientific/static acceptance remains in force.
Bounded child work (reuse these tickets rather than reimplementing inside this parent):
- bd-01M35A79XQJRP3JTHJYVQ741YZ — [Workspace] Qualify the current runtime and publication baseline
- bd-01M35A7A2XPBXBSTP1FXM7PQMX — [Workspace] Repair canonical recall traversal in existing Voyage
This issue retains integrated acceptance/original broader scope. Its new local dependency chain covers child delivery; child closure alone is not proof of the parent acceptance. Do not add a child dependency back to this parent.
